description:
Delete a dead export and demote every repository-state `pub` item that has no consumer outside the module, keeping only the items pinned by an external contract and moving integration-test-only publics behind the test-support feature.

## Background

The adversarial audit catalogued a dead export and thirteen over-broad `pub` items in `crates/jit/src/repository_state/`. `issue_draft` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/mutation.rs:1314`, re-exported at `crates/jit/src/repository_state/mod.rs:58`) has zero callers in production, tests, or the server crate. The remaining items are `pub` but have no consumer outside `repository_state`. The disposition, verified during planning, resolves the list as eight demotions, four contract-pinned keeps, three test-only publics moved behind the `test-support` feature, and one deletion.

**Delete:** `issue_draft` and its re-export.

**Demote to `pub(crate)` (eight items):** the five clean items `compose_managed_documents`, `finalize_audit_append`, `profile_applied_event`, `FixedMutationClock`, and `default_rule_membership_diff_from_identities`; and three items whose non-candidate producers must be co-demoted so the demotion compiles - `ValidationCaptureClosure` together with `validate_capture_closure`, `DefaultRuleMembershipDiff` together with `default_rule_membership_diff`, and `InjectivityProof` together with `RepositoryLayout::injectivity_proof`.

**Keep `pub` (four contract-pinned items):** `CompleteProjectionConfig`, `SetStringTarget`, `KeyedArrayTarget`, and `MapEntryTarget`. These are the `Contribution` variant payload types reachable through the public `ProfileManifest.contributions` JsonSchema wire contract, so they are legitimately part of the external surface.

**Move behind `test-support` (three items):** `SerializedRuleSet`, `SchemaFile`, and `serialize_ruleset` are `pub` solely for integration-test crates. Gate them with the established `test-support` feature twin pattern - public under the feature, `pub(crate)` without it - rather than leaving them on the default surface.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `issue_draft` is removed from `repository_state/mutation.rs` and its re-export at `repository_state/mod.rs`; no reference to it remains in the crate, the tests, or the server crate.
- [hard] REQ-02: `compose_managed_documents`, `finalize_audit_append`, `profile_applied_event`, `FixedMutationClock`, `default_rule_membership_diff_from_identities`, `ValidationCaptureClosure` (with `validate_capture_closure`), `DefaultRuleMembershipDiff` (with `default_rule_membership_diff`), and `InjectivityProof` (with `RepositoryLayout::injectivity_proof`) are `pub(crate)` and no longer reachable from the crate's public API.
- [hard] REQ-03: `CompleteProjectionConfig`, `SetStringTarget`, `KeyedArrayTarget`, and `MapEntryTarget` remain `pub` and continue to serialize through the `ProfileManifest.contributions` JsonSchema contract unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-04: `SerializedRuleSet`, `SchemaFile`, and `serialize_ruleset` are exposed only under the `test-support` feature (public with the feature, `pub(crate)` without) and are absent from the default public surface.
- [hard] REQ-05: The workspace builds, `cargo test --workspace` passes, and `cargo clippy --lib` on the feature-off surface reports zero warnings.

## Notes

This task shares files with the feature-gating work and must land after it, so the visibility baseline and the `test-support` twin pattern already exist when these items are moved onto it.
title: Reduce the repository-state public surface to its external consumers
